patch.value: Adopt the canonical pm-ops docstring gate

Adopt the canonical pm-ops docstring coverage analyzer as the single fleet-wide docstring gate: add pm-ops as a devDependency, a thin scripts/docstring-gate.ts launcher that calls analyzeDocstringCoverage (no vendored analyzer), wire it into release:check and CI, and write real JSDoc for every flagged declaration until the gate reports zero violations.

scripts/docstring-gate.ts is a thin launcher over pm-ops/docstrings analyzeDocstringCoverage (no vendored/forked analyzer); npm run docstring reports zero violations (34 violations fixed in index.ts); release:check is fully green: typecheck, build, docstring, coverage, audit, pack, changelog check; CI runs a 'Verify complete docstring coverage' step before the coverage step (no existing step renamed); a behavioral test covers the gate runGate/main/isMainInvocation wiring

value.text: Docstring gate initially reported 34 violations in index.ts; added a self-contained scripts/docstring-gate.ts launcher over pm-ops/docstrings analyzeDocstringCoverage (matching this repo's coverage-gate.ts style, no shared launcher module), a behavioral test, and real JSDoc for every flagged declaration. Gate now reports 0 violations (3 files, 43 declarations documented).
